import csv, io, os, requests
from pathlib import Path
key=Path(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read_text().strip()
ids={
'iron':'f9cad7b01a4721354f84b71820cca82b',
'innate':'f9cad7b01a4721351a77ef21d8a23efe',
'iron_summary':'f9cad7b01a47213579aba4c78331377d',
'innate_summary':'f9cad7b01a472135e699ef187ee3a053'}
def get(did):
    r=requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/datasets/{did}/display',headers={'x-api-key':key},timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
sets={}
for label in ('iron','innate'):
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(get(ids[label])),delimiter='\\t'))
    sig={r['pathway_id']:r['pathway_name'] for r in rows if float(r['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05}
    sets[label]=sig
    print(label, len(rows), len(sig), sorted(sig))
only=sorted(set(sets['iron'])-set(sets['innate']))
print('iron_only',len(only),[(x,sets['iron'][x]) for x in only])
print('IRON SUMMARY')
print(get(ids['iron_summary']).strip())
print('INNATE SUMMARY')
print(get(ids['innate_summary']).strip())
PY"
